prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: Children making a home music film with a camera, radio and screen showing their performance. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Music and Film". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Radio, television, video, film.
Camera ready, sound very low.
Save one voice and watch the show.
Album, movie, favorite star.
Touch the key and turn the radio.
Memory, music, one little smile.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
